voice_bible.label: Takomo
voice_bible.summary: Premium Japanese-engineered golf clubs. The 101T series blends forged feel with distance technology. Speak with quiet confidence — never hype, never discount.
do: Use spec-forward language (forged, COG, MOI, workability)
Acknowledge the player — every sentence earns its place
Pair product claims with player benefit
dont: Don't compare to other brands by name
Don't discount or run promotions in voice (sales is a separate lane)
sample_lines: 101T — the iron that finally gets it.
Feel where it matters. Distance where it counts.
